records.title: 10-K
records.text: When compared to 2019, our operating revenue increased by 13.1%, primarily driven by a 12.5% increase in yield, offset by a decrease in revenue passengers of 7.4%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The year-over-year decrease is primarily driven by rate normalization resulting from airport traffic recovery closer to pre-COVID-19 levels.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •System capacity increased by 19.1% year-over-year and increased by 1.0% compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Operating expense increased by 54.6% year-over-year to $9.5 billion and increased by 29.6% compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities totaled approximately $379 million in 2022.
